article:
The chat is a workbench

You do not need a prompt library. You need a thread that still knows what you are building. Talk like a person who can see the screen. “The button is too low.” “This page 404s.” “Save this as files I can deploy.” Short. Specific. Mean the file you mean.

A good prompt is not poetry. It is a clear want plus the last error.

What to put in the thread

The sentence that describes the product. The file that is broken, or a screenshot of it. The error, pasted, not paraphrased. A constraint: “paper site, no framework,” “Mac menu bar,” “do not add a database yet.”

What not to put in: your API keys. Other people’s private email. A novel about your childhood unless the product is about your childhood.

When to start a new chat

When the old one is arguing with a version of the app that no longer exists. When you changed jobs — code to film, film to invoices. When the model keeps “fixing” a file you already deleted.

Do not start a new chat every time you feel awkward. That is how you lose the plot. Summarise the current truth at the top if the thread is long: what exists, where it lives, what is broken.

How I actually do it

This site was built in threads that were allowed to stay ugly. “Change Built to Build.” “Embed parallel51.grok.me.” “The homepage is a character, not a school.” I attach the file that is wrong. I do not re-explain the whole brand every turn.

Agents and MCP come later. First you learn to steer one conversation that can see a folder.

Where noobs get stuck

Writing a page of “act as a senior engineer.” The model already knows how to write code. It does not know what you can see. The other stuck: dumping the whole repo every time, or dumping nothing and hoping.

Film this

Break a page on purpose. Paste the error. Show the fix landing. Then show a bad prompt — vague, polite, no file — and the mush that comes back. Same model. Different steering.

Do this before chapter 04

  • Keep one thread for one product for a whole evening.
  • Paste an error instead of describing it.
  • Give one constraint the model keeps violating, and repeat it until it sticks.
  • When you start a new chat, paste a six-line status, not a memoir.

Next: languages — English first, then the few a shipped product actually needs.
